## Agent handoff contract (required for implementation PRs)

- [ ] Read root AGENTS.md, docs/agents/STATUS.md and docs/agents/NEXT_STEPS.md.
- [ ] Created/updated a unique docs/agents/tasks/YYYY-MM-DD-topic.md record with current status, plan, progress, verification, risks and exact next action.
- [ ] Updated docs/agents/STATUS.md with verified implementation, CI and deployment truth.
- [ ] Updated docs/agents/NEXT_STEPS.md with prioritized unfinished tasks and blockers.
- [ ] Updated architecture/decision documents if architecture or external dependencies changed.
- [ ] Did not commit secrets, OTP values, student data or sensitive logs.
- [ ] Did not modify production, live data or real payments without explicit approval.

## Verification evidence

Commands, GitHub Actions run, pass/fail results, environment, remaining untested cases.
